post.summary: Sends a 6-digit login code to the e-mail. Always 202, whether the e-mail exists or not.
Checks the code and starts a session. Creates the account on the first login.
Replaces the refresh token by a new one and returns a new access token.

get.summary: Gets the signed-in account and its player.

post.summary: Creates the player of the signed-in account. Returns an access token with the player.
Creates a group. The signed-in player is the president and its first regular member.

get.summary: Lists the groups of the signed-in player.
Gets a group with its members, pairs and coach rotation.

post.summary: Adds a regular or substitute member.
Adds a member by the e-mail of their account. The person must have created their profile.

put.summary: Sets the coach order. It must list every regular member exactly once.

post.summary: Creates a season for the group (default: 6 months).

get.summary: Lists the seasons of the group, newest first.

post.summary: Opens the list of a match date, with every regular pending.

get.summary: Lists the group's most recent lists, with their lineup and match.

post.summary: Starts the lineup of a closed list and picks the coach of the week.
Records the score of the match played with a completed lineup.

get.summary: Season ranking: points (win 3, draw 1), then attendances, then wins.
Gets the list with who plays, who is pending and who is waiting.

put.summary: The signed-in player changes their positions.

delete.summary: The signed-in player declines or leaves the list.

post.summary: Closes the list. Pending regulars lose their spot.
The president picks the coach's partner when their pair is not playing.

put.summary: The coach splits the players, without themselves and their partner.

post.summary: The partner picks a team; the coach goes to the other one and to the end of the rotation.

put.summary: Fixes a score that was recorded wrong.
